newsitem.title: UK: Late sell-off in LIFFE white sugar.
newsitem.headline: Late sell-off in LIFFE white sugar.

text.p: White sugar prices took a late dive on LIFFE as a burst of selling near the close overwhelmed the few buyers that were around.
There did not appear any news behind the sell-off and New York futures movements were not significant on the downside, traders said.
Near March traded down to $301.80 at the close, down $1.40 a tonne from Monday's close, after business at $304.40 not long before the close. Turnover totalled 2,59 lots.
Earlier white sugar futures had perked up in late afternoon trade as a show of strength on New York raws stirred sentiment but the turnover mostly derived from against actuals and crossed trades.
